js-sum-mixed-values.alternative: function sumMixed(values){let total=0;for(const value of values)total+=Number(value);return total;}

js-count-nested-keys.alternative: function countKeys(object){let count=0;for(const key in object){if(!Object.hasOwn(object,key))continue;count++;const value=object[key];if(value!==null&&typeof value==="object"&&!Array.isArray(value))count+=countKeys(value);}return count;}
